prompt:
One panel of a wordless five-panel story sequence for a mystery adventure video game.

Scene: the same riverside sports park at dusk as before: flat grass beside the dirt edge of a small ballfield, a low grassy river embankment, a wide calm river and a long steel truss bridge far in the distance. Strong backlight: the sun is low near the horizon, amber (the spot colour). Seen from behind in the foreground, the girl with the high ponytail stands upright holding the white ball in her mitt and casually raises her other hand toward her brother in a light reassuring wave. The boy stands still far away on the grass, a small silhouette facing her. Their two shadows stretch long and calm across the field. Deceptively peaceful, as if nothing at all has happened. Flat riverside ground only: NO hilltop, NO lake, NO islands, NO church, NO town below.

Recurring characters in this story: an 18-year-old girl with a long high black ponytail, a plain white T-shirt and dark shorts, a leather softball catcher's mitt on her left hand; her little brother, a slim ten-year-old boy in a plain T-shirt and shorts, bareheaded.

Format: ONE single wordless (silent) manga / graphic-novel panel that fills the whole canvas edge to edge: full bleed, no panel border, no gutter, no multi-panel page layout. Art style: bold confident black ink brush and pen linework, crisp cross-hatching and printed dot screentone (halftone) for all greys and shadows, on warm off-white paper (#F2EAD8). The image is essentially black ink on paper EXCEPT for ONE single spot accent colour, warm amber (#FFB020), used sparingly only where the scene says; no other colours. Dynamic cinematic composition, dramatic camera angle, strong readable silhouettes, deep blacks, elegant and restrained, intelligent and quietly unsettling mystery mood, respectful and non-graphic. Figures are drawn as dark silhouettes or seen from behind; faces are never shown. Premium published graphic-novel quality.

ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT OF ANY KIND ANYWHERE: no lettering, no speech balloons, no thought bubbles, no caption boxes, no narration boxes, no sound-effect lettering or onomatopoeia (neither Japanese kana/kanji nor Latin letters), no numbers or numerals (clocks, screens and dials are blank), no signs or signage, no labels, no brand names, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no panel number. Use only pictures, lines, tone and light. NO gore, NO blood, NO wounds, NO injuries shown, NO dead bodies, NO nudity, NO bare skin beyond hands, NO frightening faces.
